name: ab_prime_mul_prime_not_abundant
statement: (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) : ¬ Nat.Abundant (p * q)
closed: ∀ (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime), ¬ Nat.Abundant (p * q)
informal: Auditor's correction of Task 3(b) (not stated in paper): a product of two primes is never abundant.
source: s40753-021-00140-1 p.28 Appendix 2 Task 3(b) (auditor's corrected form; the paper gives none)
original: If p1 and p2 are primes, then p1p2 is abundant.
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → ¬(p * q).Abundant
